name: next-steps-plus
description: Suggests next prompts above the input after each turn, with fuller prompts, a preview of each, and multi-select. A configurable fork of next-steps.

selectMode.title: Selection mode
selectMode.description: multi: number keys toggle suggestions and 9 puts all picked ones in the prompt box. single: a number key puts that one suggestion in the prompt box (the original behaviour).

maxSuggestions.title: Number of suggestions
maxSuggestions.description: Show up to this many suggestions (1-8).

previewChars.title: Preview length
previewChars.description: Show this many characters of each full prompt under its label, e.g. 240. 0 (the default) hides the preview.

promptStyle.title: Prompt style
promptStyle.description: detailed: 1-3 sentences with scope and what done looks like. brief: one short sentence.

combineHeader.title: Header for several picks
combineHeader.description: Line put above the numbered list when several suggestions are picked. Empty for none.

extraInstructions.title: Extra instructions
extraInstructions.description: Your own preferences for the suggestions, e.g. 'write prompts in Thai' or 'always include a test step'.

ghostText.title: Tab ghost text
ghostText.description: Also offer the top suggestion as dim ghost text in the prompt box, taken with Tab.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.
